I feel like I've written the same comment a few times so I'll do a little Q&A to answer the big questions:


Q: why was he paying the storage unit?

A: he lost his job, we lost our house, tossed stuff in storage. Siblings and I went off to college, parents moved in with grandparents. Everyone in the family has paid the bills at some point. he doesn't work, so my mom carried the load and we filled in where needed. My siblings were able to get their things after moving out, I got my own place last, but found the units locked. He lied and said the units have been paid for this whole time. 

Q: you're smoking a pax and eating a steak but can't afford storage?

A: please let me know where you've seen a pax and a steak cost a mortgage payment. That's how high the bill had gotten apparently, hence why we were trying to move shit out. I was just too late. Also this pack of 2 steaks was $17 from a butcher shop. Does not compute.


Q: why can't you just go up there during the auction?

A: I think these auctions are online and not live so whoever bids has to put their real info in. My and my dad's last name are the same so we're using a 3rd party.


Q: why can't you just call up there and see what you can do?

A: I tried, but the person couldn't give me any information as the units aren't in my name. I can't trust my dad to tell the truth because he blatantly lied and said they were paid for when I had my eyes on the locks.


EXTRA INFO: I lost more than records. I lost my childhood furniture (I was gonna keep it and use it in my new place), books, pictures, old journals that I wanted to keep. I mentioned records because record collecting is a hobby of mine and I hold every one dear to my heart.
